glosses: A gas or vapour/vapor that is strong-smelling or dangerous to inhale.

examples.text: Don't stand around in there breathing the fumes while the adhesive cures.
the fumes of new-shorn hay

glosses: A material that has been vaporized from the solid or liquid state to the gas state and re-coalesced to the solid state.

examples.text: Lead fume is a greyish powder, mainly comprising lead sulfate.

glosses: Rage or excitement which deprives the mind of self-control.

examples.text: The Fumes of his Passion do as really intoxicate and confound his judging and discerning Faculty , as the Fumes of Drink discompose and stupify the Brain of a Man over - charged with it.

glosses: Anything unsubstantial or airy; idle conceit; vain imagination.

glosses: The incense of praise; inordinate flattery.

examples.text: to smother him with fumes and eulogies

glosses: A passionate person.
To expose (something) to fumes; specifically, to expose wood, etc., to ammonia in order to produce dark tints.
To apply or offer incense to.

examples.text: Tyrian garbs, / Neptunian Albion's high teſtaceous food [i.e., oysters], / And flavour'd Chian wines with incenſe fum'd / To ſlake Patrician thirſt: for theſe, their rights / In the vile ſtreets they proſtitute to ſale; / Their ancient rights, their dignities, their laws, / Their native glorious freedom.
